name: @clara/backup
description: Clara off-site DR backup app (Wave A2 §8 / WA2-R6) — a SEPARATE, self-contained Fly app (`clara-backup`, sin) that dumps the full-profile DB + globals evidence + auth data-only + the firm-docs byte mirror, age-encrypts, and rclone-syncs to Cloudflare R2, pinging a dead-man's-switch on success. NOT a pnpm workspace member (excluded in pnpm-workspace.yaml); NEVER installed into @clara/runtime. Its deps are installed inside its own Docker image.
